newsitem.title: LEBANON: Saudi Crown Prince saves desperate Palestinian.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Crown Prince saves desperate Palestinian.

text.p: Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah came to the rescue on Sunday of a Palestinian refugee who threatened to sell his seven-year-old son to pay for his father's medical expenses.

Saudi Ambassador Ahmad al-Koheimi visited Nabil Refaii, 32, and his ailing 60-year-old father Ali in hospital in the southern Lebanese port of Sidon and told them Prince Abdullah had decided to pay the bill for Ali's kidney dialysis.

Refaii, a labourer who earns 15,000 Lebanese pounds ($10) a day, told reporters at Ain el-Hilweh refugee camp near Sidon on Friday that he wanted to sell his son to raise 40 million Lebanese pounds ($26,000) for his father's treatment.
He said UNRWA (U.N. Relief and Works Agency) which looks after refugees in the Palestinian camps, had failed to respond to his requests to help his father.
